purpose: Shared canonical identity and lineage expectations consumed by browser and Android restore lifecycle tests.

performance.provenanceRule: Provenance is generated by the Performance calculation service from persisted source records and asserted as calculation output; it is not a persisted source_provenance record kind.

note: The shared all-domain synthetic graph includes Finance payment/reversal/prepayment/revised-schedule/settlement lineage, effective-dated Maintenance rates and accruals, paid/unpaid challans, platform and miscellaneous expenses, and pending Work recovery/boundary cases. Production Browser/Room lifecycle and normalized parity are separate Phase 2 acceptance gates.

operatingConfiguration.referencePolicy: Every vehicle-bound record and calculation uses the configured vehicle ID; every Work/driver-attributed event and calculation uses the configured driver ID.
operatingConfiguration.compatibility: Stable IDs and legacy assignment-history readers remain supported; current fixtures do not create reassignment histories or additional entities.

emptyParticipantPolicy.required: A registered participant with zero records is valid and remains present in the manifest.
emptyParticipantPolicy.restore: Restore must clear stale rows owned by an empty participant without requiring a placeholder record.
emptyParticipantPolicy.negative: Unknown participant IDs and records whose IDs do not match the declared owner must be rejected before mutation.

data.rationale: Synthetic overlap review confirms independently issued policies.
Synthetic superseding review records the final owner decision.

canonicalSnapshotContract.participantInventory: participant IDs, feature IDs, snapshot versions and restore validator IDs; adapter implementation IDs remain platform-local
